summary.intent: Discuss and plan Phase 25 (Desktop Enhancements) for CipherBox, covering auto-update mechanism via Tauri v2 and TEE file enrollment for FUSE-created files.
summary.outcome: Phase 25 CONTEXT.md was created and committed on a feature branch, research was completed and committed as 25-RESEARCH.md, and a validation strategy (25-VALIDATION.md) was written — leaving the project ready for planning.

repo: TEE IPNS key wrapping infrastructure already exists for folder creation in crates/fuse/src/write_ops.rs (~line 499) — encrypts IPNS private key with tee_public_key and sends encrypted_ipns_private_key + key_epoch on publish
Per-file IPNS is already implemented — files have their own IPNS names in metadata
tauri.conf.json has no updater section yet — Tauri v2 updater plugin needs to be added
BYO-IPFS pinning modes exist and TEE enrollment must work for both CipherBox-pinned and BYO-pinned files
IpnsPublishRequest struct already has encrypted_ipns_private_key and key_epoch fields (same API contract needed for file enrollment)
Project uses Release Please for releases, which GitHub Releases auto-update distribution can leverage

workflow: GSD feature branches created during discuss-phase are on the worktree repo (cipher-box-worker2), not the main repo — switching context can make branches appear missing

The discuss-phase → plan-phase chain requires staying on the correct branch; always verify with git status before resuming
